experience: Theatrical character voice is immediately playable. Motive offers a room full of strong grudges; Method resolves it cleanly through intersection of three independent access facts. I used canonical prepared transcripts as asynchronous evidence, not live improvised conversations.
enjoyment: Distinctive voices and the stolen-performance grievance make reading enjoyable. Deduction becomes straightforward once F4/F5 exclude transfers and duplicate access; dramatic suspect shifts happened naturally from Hugh to Elon.

navigation.finding: Round titles, repeated next-person instructions and STOP boundaries made the text sequence clear. Page07 visibly gives both branches and notes. Page10 image begins inside the first box and does not show its IF INNOCENT label or Your answer instruction at the top.
navigation.limitation: Read staged text and inspected two PNGs after locking; physical page flipping was not tested.

question_matching.finding: All transcript questions match the named question groups and each prepared answer responds to its prompt. Dada can ask Elon from the first Questions page; Anya is on the second.
question_matching.risk: The host tracking answered names is necessary when 16 names are spread among 30 listed.

repetition.quote: Choose by name / Everyone answers once / Turn only within this round
repetition.finding: Opportunity questions are nearly identical across all ten groups. Method answers repeatedly use That was what the materials desk issued me. This makes facts easy to compare but reduces the sense of a spontaneous interrogation.

present_16_vs_listed_30.quote: If a named guest is absent, discuss that subject with anyone. These social tasks do not block the investigation.
present_16_vs_listed_30.finding: Ignore absent guests handles the question list logically, but scanning names not attending adds work. Arrival asks about Minnie, who is absent; its fallback prevents blockage.

note_space.finding: Page07 shows only three long ruled lines: enough for a shortlist, not a 16-person salon/key/linen matrix. Method page10 shows no notes area, when the decisive comparisons arrive.
note_space.limitation: Visual estimate only; handwriting and actual note-taking on paper were not tested.

memory_load.finding: Tracking sixteen motives and three facts per guest encourages a comparison grid. The preparation records recap salon/key/material facts and reduce reliance on prior rounds.
memory_load.limitation: Animal choice and inference were simulated with stored notes; no claim of testing human recall.

branch_safety.visual_issue: Provided Method PNG lacks the innocent label at its top, increasing branch orientation risk if this is how the physical page appears.
branch_safety.quote: Read the box for your role when questioned. Keep its label private.
branch_safety.finding: Correct branch selected using HORSE versus HIPPO. Motive shares one answer. Opportunity identical boxes make accidental wrong selection harmless that round. Method changes only blue paper to linen, which is decisive.

roleplay.quote: Enjoy watching people overreact to your warning note without admitting you wrote it.
roleplay.finding: The line He bought the invitation stock, not my imagination already supports performance. I could add dramatic delivery and an introduction without manufacturing clues. Secret note authorship gave a temptation to confess; background instruction specifically discouraged it.
roleplay.suggestion: Add one short explicit rule permitting attitude and gesture while keeping factual answers exact.

actual_disclosure_explanation: No animal, role label, private note authorship, or alternate-branch content was included in the simulated public answer. No additional public improvisation was transmitted; canonical transcripts are the public record.
hypothetical_risks: An extrovert might confess the warning note early while riffing, changing how the room interprets that clue.
A player reading labels aloud could disclose role.
Both Method branches visible together make the alternate clue easy to notice; page10 crop further obscures branch orientation.

prioritized_improvements.change: Verify Method page top/branch label visibility in output and retain IF INNOCENT plus read-aloud guidance on the same visible page as its answer.
prioritized_improvements.evidence: Packet-page-10.png starts with I carried blue disposable paper wipes inside a box; IF MURDERER remains clearly visible below.

prioritized_improvements.change: Provide a compact 16-attendee check-off list and evidence matrix with salon time, key loan, linen/paper columns.
prioritized_improvements.evidence: The ballot asks Evidence connecting the salon, key and linen, while page07 offers only three ruled note lines.

prioritized_improvements.change: Add a short performance boundary: Embellish delivery, not evidence; read the printed facts before any banter.
prioritized_improvements.evidence: Acting is optional; these printed facts are enough supports acting but does not expressly define its factual limit.

prioritized_improvements.change: Use a host-marked attendee roster or strike absent names on question pages before distribution.
prioritized_improvements.evidence: Ignore absent guests still leaves thirty names to scan for sixteen participants.
